light.step_cost: max(1, light dampening of the cell entered)
light.sky_sources: every cell above the highest block with nonzero light dampening is level 15
light.dampening: 15 for solid-render blocks, 0 where skylight propagates down (non-full shape, no fluid, glass), otherwise 1

spawn_floor.default: top face sturdy and light emission below 14

monster_light.rule: fail if sky > nextInt(32); fail if block light > the dimension's limit (when below 15); pass if max(sky - darken, block) <= the dimension's light test sample
monster_light.thundering: Level.isThundering: canHaveWeather and (double) getThunderLevel(1) > thundering_above; getThunderLevel = lerp(oThunderLevel, thunderLevel) * getRainLevel

sky_darken.weather_rule: lerp(rainLevel - thunderLevel, base, rainModifier(base)); then lerp(thunderLevel, base, thunderModifier(base))

natural_spawner.start: x, z uniform in a 16x16 chunk; y uniform from min_y to WORLD_SURFACE + 1; nothing below min_y + 1

model: Scenes are original. Each step adds its edits to a flat world (stone up to y = 63, air above) and is reproduced from scratch: light by fixed-point relaxation, spawn odds out of 256 for a zombie with Java's ON_GROUND checks and isDarkEnoughToSpawn at sky darkening 11 (clear night) and 0 (noon).
